judge.rationale: The candidate correctly updates `chatOrchestrator.ts` to call `onError` on all rejections, wrapping non-Error values in an `Error` with `cause` set to the original value while re-throwing the original value untouched. It also updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` as required by the ticket. Instead of adding the test to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference, the candidate creates two new test files (`onErrorCause.test.ts`, `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`) and places a test helper file (`src/orchestration/rejectingProvider.ts`) directly into the production `src/` directory, plus leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree. Additionally, while the string rejection test in `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` verifies `message`, it does not explicitly assert `error.cause === 'string boom'` in the test expectation (though the implementation sets it and `undefined`/object tests verify `cause`). Using `node:util`'s `inspect` instead of `JSON.stringify` with fallback is a clean, cycle-safe way to format the error message.
